verdict.rationale: HubSpot has extensive, well-documented public REST APIs (contacts, custom objects, webhooks) with clear endpoint examples like POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts, plus a CLI and official MCP servers for both CRM data and developer platform access enabling agentic tool integration. While standard discovery probes (llms.txt, openapi.json) failed, the documented guides and MCP server directly satisfy programmatic/agent-driven access.
